pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding positions within 15 seconds of a previous fill or into an unconfirmed directional velocity vector.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Order execution requires an order-book imbalance ratio > 1.8 and a confirmed 5-tick momentum delta matching the entry vector, completely blocking counter-wick entries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stop protection at +$8.00 and execute tiered profit harvesting starting at +$15.00 to force asymmetric distributions.
